text: Carolina strikes first. 7–0.
Cincinnati answers right away. 7–7.
Then Gio Bernard breaks loose for 89 yards. 14–7, Bengals.
Cincinnati takes a 17–10 lead into halftime. It feels like their day.
Then Andy Dalton starts handing the game away.
Carolina makes him pay at once. 17–17.
Cam Newton runs it in. Carolina leads 24–17.
Dalton is picked off again. The Bengals look done.
Twelve minutes left. Dalton finds Sanu deep. 24–24.
Under five minutes. Newton finds Olsen. Carolina back in front, 31–24.
Pacman Jones takes the kickoff. And runs. And runs...
...97 yards, and Cincinnati ties it in one breath. 31–31.
Newton is intercepted. Now Carolina is in trouble.
Two minutes left. Nugent puts the Bengals up 34–31. It should be over.
Five seconds left, down three. One kick to save Carolina...
Good. 34–34. Overtime.
Overtime. Nugent puts the Bengals ahead, 37–34. Carolina gets one last chance.
Two minutes left. Gano answers again. 37–37.
Two seconds left. One kick to win it...
Wide right. Seventy-five minutes, and nobody wins.
